Problem Statement:
Write a program to implement a circular queue using an array in Java. 
Input Description:
First line: queue size
Following lines: commands (enqueue X, dequeue, display). End with "exit". 
Output Description:
Queue contents after each display command. 
Sample Input:
5
enqueue 1
enqueue 2
enqueue 3
dequeue
enqueue 4
enqueue 5
enqueue 6
display
exit 
Sample Output:
2 3 4 5 6
